protocol: Eight-player lobbies; V0/V1/V2/V3/V5 each 1-2 seats in ten balanced lineups; 32 lobbies per lineup; stochastic BF16 neural inference; frozen weights.
unit: One model seat from episode start to its terminal placement (player-game).
definition: model_actions counts ready actions excluding native deferred actions; native rejected actions were zero. Includes hero/menu/End decisions; excludes automatic combat and native V0 actions.
quantile_method: numpy.percentile(method='linear'); sorted index (n-1)*p; fractional percentiles are interpolated action counts.

unavailable.v0_action_counts: V0 is advanced internally by native code; no V0 action counters saved.
unavailable.cycle_returns: No per-transition observations, visible-state hashes or cycle counters saved.
unavailable.zero_cycle_player_games: Cannot identify player-games without repeated visible states.
unavailable.actions_per_turn: No per-turn action counts or turn boundaries saved.
unavailable.cap_end_rate: No per-turn action masks or forced-End events saved.
unavailable.action_id_repetition: No ordered action IDs saved; distinct from visible-state cycles.

limitations: Shorter total action counts do not establish fewer cycles or zero repetition.
Total actions also depend on survival duration; no per-turn normalization is possible here.
This is post-hoc analysis of existing records, not a new match or training run.
